dichloromethane.name: Dichloromethane
dichloromethane.caption: Both chlorines and both hydrogens sit on the one carbon.

trichloromethane.name: Trichloromethane (chloroform)
trichloromethane.caption: One hydrogen is left on the carbon — the bond that air and light attack.

triiodomethane.name: Triiodomethane (iodoform)
triiodomethane.caption: Three large iodine atoms crowded onto a single carbon.

tetrachloromethane.name: Tetrachloromethane (carbon tetrachloride)
tetrachloromethane.caption: No hydrogen at all, so there is no C–H bond for oxidation to attack.

phosgene.name: Phosgene (carbonyl chloride)
phosgene.caption: Two chlorines on a carbonyl carbon — a far better electrophile than the CHCl₃ it came from.

freon_12.name: Freon-12 (dichlorodifluoromethane)
freon_12.caption: Two fluorines and two chlorines replacing the four chlorines of CCl₄.

ddt.name: DDT
ddt.caption: A CCl₃ group and two para-chlorinated rings carried on one carbon.

chlorobenzene.name: Chlorobenzene
chlorobenzene.caption: The chlorine is bonded to an sp² ring carbon, not to an sp³ chain carbon.

biphenyl.name: Biphenyl (diphenyl)
biphenyl.caption: Two benzene rings joined directly by a single C–C bond.

butan_2_ol_r.name: (R)-Butan-2-ol
butan_2_ol_r.caption: (R)-Butan-2-ol: four different groups on C-2, so the mirror image is a different molecule.

butan_2_ol_s.name: (S)-Butan-2-ol
butan_2_ol_s.caption: (S)-Butan-2-ol: the mirror image of its neighbour, and not superimposable on it.

dibromopropane.name: 1,2-Dibromopropane
dibromopropane.caption: One bromine on each of two adjacent carbons — the vic-dibromide that decolourises bromine water.

sec_butyl_chloride.name: sec-Butyl chloride (2-chlorobutane)
sec_butyl_chloride.caption: Chlorine on the second carbon of the butane chain, used to show numbering in IUPAC names.

neo_pentyl_bromide.name: neo-Pentyl bromide (1-bromo-2,2-dimethylpropane)
neo_pentyl_bromide.caption: A compact skeleton: three methyl groups and a CH2Br on one carbon.

tert_butyl_bromide.name: tert-Butyl bromide (2-bromo-2-methylpropane)
tert_butyl_bromide.caption: Bromine on a tertiary carbon carrying three methyl groups.

vinyl_chloride.name: Vinyl chloride (chloroethene)
vinyl_chloride.caption: Chlorine bonded directly to an sp2 carbon of the double bond.

allyl_bromide.name: Allyl bromide (3-bromopropene)
allyl_bromide.caption: Bromine on the carbon next to the double bond.

o_chlorotoluene.name: o-Chlorotoluene (1-chloro-2-methylbenzene)
o_chlorotoluene.caption: Methyl and chlorine on adjacent carbons of the ring.

benzyl_chloride.name: Benzyl chloride (chlorophenylmethane)
benzyl_chloride.caption: Chlorine on the CH2 attached to the benzene ring.
